work.title: Workshop floor
work.emptyRepairBody: New work orders show up here automatically. Scan a bike to create one from a ticket.
work.emptyBuildBody: Bikes on open manufacturing orders show up here. Create an MO and add bikes to start a batch.
work.chipPartsShort: {count, plural, one {1 part short} other {# parts short}}

wo.workPerformedDescription: What did you do? Parts replaced, adjustments, observations.
wo.readOnlyNote: This work order is {status}. Notes are read-only — re-open via the desktop view if you need to edit.
wo.notesPlaceholder: Type, or tap Dictate / your keyboard's mic key.
wo.micTip: 💡 Tip: the mic key on your phone's keyboard also works.
wo.partsEmpty: No parts consumed yet. Add the parts you actually used so the bike's service history and the invoice match.
wo.photosEmpty: No photos yet. Snap one if a part needs explaining.
wo.photoProcessError: Could not process the photo. Try again.

woParts.kitNotice: {code}: added {added, plural, one {1 part} other {# parts}}.
woParts.kitNoticeSkipped: {code}: added {added, plural, one {1 part} other {# parts}}, {skipped} already on the work order.
woParts.trayEmpty: Nothing yet — grab a kit above or add parts below.

dictate.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support in-app dictation. Tap the mic key on your keyboard instead.
dictate.errorBlocked: Microphone access was blocked. Check your browser permissions.
dictate.errorNetwork: Couldn't reach the browser's speech service. On a laptop this often fails — try again, type in the box above, or use your keyboard's mic key.
dictate.errorNoMic: No microphone found. Plug one in, or type in the box above.

build.frameConfirmedHint: Frame confirmed. Update it here if it was mistyped.
build.frameEnterHint: Enter the real frame number stamped on this bike — required before you can finish the build.
build.noIdentifiers: No lock / battery / GPS identifiers registered yet.

batchBuild.title: Bulk build
batchBuild.intro: Build several identical bikes at once — the parts come from the recipe; you only enter each bike's frame number and identifiers here.
batchBuild.moClosed: This MO is {status} — nothing left to build.
batchBuild.noUnbuilt: No unbuilt bikes on this MO. Add bikes from the MO page first.
batchBuild.howMany: How many are you building now?

batchBuild.buildN: Build {count, plural, one {1 bike} other {# bikes}}

recipe.allInRecipe: Every part in this kit is already in the recipe.

identifierDialog.title: Register identifier
identifierDialog.description: Identifiers can be added at any point in the bike's lifecycle — missing ones don't block status changes.

scan.title: Scan QR sticker
scan.pageHint: Point the back camera at any Jensen bike sticker. The page will navigate as soon as the code is recognised.
scan.cameraFailedBody: {message}. Check the browser permission, or paste a frame number / bike URL below.
scan.manualLabel: Or enter a frame number / paste a URL
scan.installIos: Tired of allowing the camera every time? Tap the share button in Safari, then Add to Home Screen. Launching from the home-screen icon remembers the camera permission and feels like a native app.
scan.installAndroid: Tired of allowing the camera every time? Open your browser menu and pick Install app (or Add to Home Screen). Launched from the home-screen icon the camera permission sticks.
